column1: # TEN FROZEN SIMULATOR-SOURCE BLOCKS, and what could actually be checked.
# CORRECTED -- see MASTER_SIM_ARTIFACT_MAP.tsv and ledger section 51.  The
# conclusion below ("not executable, no branch has a generator") was a MAPPING
# ERROR: it searched only for master's Direction-2 make_sim_launcher.py / Sims/
# route.  All three pins DO emit simulator source, natively, from
# pass/lean/pass_lean.cpp -> <base>_Lgraph.lean.  The ten-block criterion stands
# and is NOT replaced by anything in this file.  What this file records --
# generator preservation across the port, and generator determinism -- remains
# true and remains scoped to master's Direction-2 launcher only.
# Section 6.4 of this ledger asks, as a FINAL-ACCEPTANCE requirement, that the
# generated simulator source be produced twice -- once on each original branch
# with THAT BRANCH'S OWN generator, once on rebased master -- and compared byte
# for byte.  The following is true of the Direction-2 launcher SPECIFICALLY, and
# of nothing else:
#   D3  livehd-d3-translation-validation @ 78a3e0d8c   no make_sim_launcher,
#   D4  livehd-d4-incremental            @ f6ad1fe29   no sim_launcher, no
#   FP  livehd-futamura/livehd           @ 9bb41a09d   Sims/ tree, and no
#                                                      .py/.sh/.lean on any of
#                                                      the three references Sims/
# `make_sim_launcher.py` is a DIRECTION-2 artifact and exists only on master; its
# own docstring says so ("Direction 2's executable is a GENERIC simulator over
# DesignCert").  It is NOT the artifact section 6.4 should have named.  Section
# 6.4 forbids three substitutions -- behavioural equality, cross-backend
# comparison, and any new equivalence proof -- and none is offered here or
# anywhere else.  What this file records is two narrower things, about the
# launcher only:
#  1. PRESERVATION, directly.  The D3/D4/FP port never touched the generator.
#     Its last change is 4ab3ac566 ("sim: run the ported launcher"), 77 commits
#     before the port's first commit 73dee5673.  The file is byte-unchanged
#     across the whole port, which is a stronger statement about preservation
#     than regenerating and diffing outputs would be.
#  2. DETERMINISM, measured.  The ten blocks below were frozen and written to
#     generated/master_port/sim_frozen10.json BEFORE anything was generated.
#     The generator then ran TWICE over exactly those ten, same inode (hard
#     linked into two throwaway trees), same toolchain, no flags.  Both passes
#     exit 0 and emit 20 files; `diff -r` over the two Sims trees is EMPTY, the
#     two lakefile stanzas are identical, and the two sha256 listings match line
#     for line.  Raw bytes, not normalised.
# This is determinism of master's DIRECTION-2 LAUNCHER.  It is NOT the section
# 6.4 preservation check, it is not a substitute for any of the thirty byte
# comparisons, and it is not offered as one.  The real 6.4 route is the native
# pass.lean emitter; see MASTER_SIM_ARTIFACT_MAP.tsv.
